cohort.selection_rule: all registered first-repeat-stall cases, with no result-based exclusion

plateau_definition.trigger: the frozen first_repeat_stall pre-action decision from root_diagnostic_cases; its outcome was not used by the source audit
plateau_definition.segment: maximal consecutive flat transition run immediately preceding trigger, extended through trigger and later transitions only while conflicts_before equals conflicts_after and both equal the trigger pre-action conflict count
plateau_definition.strict_escape: the first transition after the segment has conflicts_after lower than conflicts_before
plateau_definition.worsening_exit: the first transition after the segment has conflicts_after greater than conflicts_before
plateau_definition.right_censored: the trace ends while the segment remains at the same conflict count
plateau_definition.exact_repair_noop: agent paths and conflict-edge set are both unchanged
plateau_definition.persistent_core: intersection of conflict edges over all pre/post states inside the segment

registration_amendment.reason: the first integrity-only execution established that first_repeat_stall denotes the third repeated candidate before its outcome, while only its two preceding actions are frozen zero-progress observations

changes: entry_after_strict_progress now refers only to the transition immediately before the maximal plateau
unique PP seed and repair-order fractions are reported to distinguish repeated selection from repeated PP realization
post-hoc descriptive Spearman and repairability-rate buckets relate the frozen 16-seed causal label to observed plateau length
post-hoc trigger-pool opportunity checks whether each future set-change escape was already available at the frozen trigger decision

escape_witness_definition.dominant_plateau_candidate: most frequent candidate_id in the plateau, ties broken by first occurrence then candidate_id
escape_witness_definition.set_change_escape: strict escape action agent set differs from the dominant plateau candidate agent set
escape_witness_definition.same_set_escape: strict escape action agent set equals the dominant plateau candidate agent set
escape_witness_definition.same_candidate_escape: strict escape action candidate_id equals the dominant plateau candidate_id
escape_witness_definition.order_change: repair_order differs from the final plateau attempt
escape_witness_definition.added_agents: strict escape action agents minus dominant plateau candidate agents
escape_witness_definition.external_blocker_overlap: added_agents intersect union of external_blocker_agents observed in all selected_native_order causal-audit trials
